drills.title: Cone slalom dribble
drills.summary: Weave through a line of cones keeping the ball close, then accelerate out.
drills.setup: Six cones in a line, 2 m apart, with a start cone 3 m before the first. One ball per player; several lines can run side by side.
instructions: Dribble in and out of the cones to the end.
Accelerate for 3 m after the last cone.
Turn and dribble back on the other side.
coaching_points: Small touches with both the inside and outside of the foot.
Keep the ball within a step of your feet.
Head up between touches to see the next cone.

variations.title: Wide cones, walking pace
variations.change: Cones 3 m apart; walk the ball through, any part of the foot.
variations.setup: Six cones in a line, 3 m apart, with a start cone 3 m before the first. One ball per player.
coaching_points: Keep the ball close enough to touch on every step.
Use any part of the foot that feels comfortable.
Look at the next cone before you reach it.

variations.title: Both feet, jogging
variations.change: Cones 2 m apart; alternate feet on each cone.

variations.title: Weaker foot only
variations.change: Use only the weaker foot, inside and outside.
coaching_points: Use only the weaker foot: inside to cut in, outside to push away.
Shorter, softer touches than with the stronger foot.
Head up between touches to see the next cone.

variations.title: Tight cones against the clock
variations.change: Cones 1 m apart; timed runs; coach calls a colour at the end and the player must look up to name it.
variations.setup: Six cones in a line, 1 m apart, with a start cone 3 m before the first. Coach stands at the end with coloured bibs or cones to call.
instructions: Dribble through the cones as fast as you can while keeping control.
As you leave the last cone the coach calls a colour; look up and shout it.
Time each run; try to beat your best time without touching a cone.
coaching_points: Tiny touches every step; both feet.
Scan up as you exit the cones: the call comes early.
Speed only matters if you keep the ball.

media.caption: Weave through the cones, then accelerate

steps.label: Dribble to the right of the first cone
Cut back left of the second
Right of the third
Left of the fourth
Right of the fifth
Left of the sixth
Accelerate out

media.caption: Inside and outside touches with both feet (DICK'S, 31 seconds): the touch technique used through the cones.

drills.title: Receive and turn
drills.summary: Open the body before the ball arrives, turn on the first touch and play forward.
drills.setup: Three players in a line: a server at one end, a receiver in the middle, a target at the other end, 10 m apart. A cone gate marks where the receiver starts.
instructions: The server passes to the receiver.
The receiver turns with the first touch and passes to the target.
Rotate positions after six passes.
coaching_points: Check over the shoulder before the ball arrives.
Open up half-sideways so the first touch can go forward.
First touch into space, not under your feet.

variations.title: Receive, stop and pass
variations.change: Receiver may take as many touches as needed and face the server.
instructions: The server passes to the receiver.
The receiver controls the ball, faces the target, and passes.
Rotate positions after six passes.
coaching_points: Cushion the ball with the inside of the foot.
Get the ball out of your feet before you pass.
Pass firmly along the ground to the target.

variations.title: Turn on the first touch
variations.change: Receiver opens the body and turns with the first touch.

variations.title: Passive defender behind
variations.change: A defender stands behind the receiver and shadows the turn without tackling.
variations.setup: As the base version, with a defender starting 2 m behind the receiver.
coaching_points: Check over your shoulder to see where the defender is.
Turn away from the side the defender is on.
First touch takes the ball past the defender, not into them.

variations.title: Live defender, two touches
variations.change: The defender competes for the ball; the receiver must turn and pass within two touches.
variations.setup: As the base version, with a defender starting 2 m behind the receiver.
instructions: The server passes to the receiver; the defender competes for the ball.
The receiver must turn and pass to the target within two touches.
If the defender wins the ball they pass it to the server; rotate after six attempts.
coaching_points: Scan early: know where the defender is before the pass.
If the turn is not on, bounce it back to the server.
Two touches: control away from pressure, then pass.

steps.label: Receiver checks the shoulder and opens up
Server passes
First touch turns into space
Pass to the target

media.caption: Escalator: a passive defender shadows the turn

steps.label: Receiver checks where the defender is
Server passes; defender closes
Turn away from the defender
Pass to the target

media.caption: Escalator: a live defender, turn and pass within two touches

steps.label: Receiver scans: the defender is tight on the right shoulder
Server passes; the defender steps in to win it
Touch 1: away from pressure, past the defender's left
Touch 2: pass to the target before the defender recovers

media.caption: Half-turn passing and receiving exercise (The DiBernardo Soccer Methodology): demonstrates opening up to receive and playing forward.

drills.title: 4v1 rondo
drills.summary: Keep the ball away from one defender with quick passes and good support angles.
drills.setup: A 10 by 10 m square. Four attackers on the edges, one defender in the middle. Spare balls at one corner.
instructions: Attackers keep possession by passing around and across the square.
If the defender wins the ball or it leaves the square, the player who lost it becomes the defender.
Count consecutive passes; set a target.
coaching_points: Move along the line to always give the passer two options.
Pass to the far foot of a teammate who is open.
Look before receiving: know where your next pass goes.

variations.title: 5v1 in a bigger square
variations.change: Five attackers in a 12 by 12 m square; unlimited touches.
variations.setup: A 12 by 12 m square. Five attackers on the edges, one defender in the middle. Spare balls at one corner.

variations.title: 4v1
variations.change: Four attackers, 10 by 10 m, unlimited touches.

variations.title: Two-touch limit
variations.change: Attackers have at most two touches.
coaching_points: Decide where the ball goes before it arrives.
First touch sets up the pass; second touch plays it.
Move along the line to always give the passer two options.

variations.title: 4v2
variations.change: Two defenders; passes through the middle split them for a bonus point.
variations.setup: A 10 by 10 m square. Four attackers on the edges, two defenders in the middle. Spare balls at one corner.
instructions: Attackers keep possession against two defenders.
A pass that splits the two defenders scores a bonus point.
If a defender wins the ball, the attacker who lost it and the defender who has been in longest swap.
coaching_points: Look for the gap between the two defenders.
When the split is not on, move the ball quickly round the outside.
Support at angles so the passer always has a safe option.

media.caption: Keep it away from the defender

steps.label: A1 plays to A2, who steps along the line to receive; A3 and A4 shift to keep two options open
A2 splits the defender with a pass across to A4; A1 and A3 slide over to support A4
A4 plays to A3 on the far side; A2 moves up to offer the next angle; the defender chases
A3 plays back to A2 before the defender closes; the cycle continues
A1 plays to A2; both defenders shift across, opening a gap between them
A2 splits the two defenders through the gap to A4: bonus point
A4 is pressed, so plays the safe ball back to A1, who has moved to support
A1 switches quickly to A2 before the defenders reset

media.caption: 4v1 rondo how-to guide (Paul Spacey). Shows a tighter 5 × 5 m square; ours starts at 10 × 10 m, shrink it as players improve.

drills.title: 1v1 to the end line
drills.summary: Beat a defender with a change of pace or direction and stop the ball on the end line.
drills.setup: A 10 by 15 m channel. The defender starts on the end line with the ball, the attacker at the far end.
instructions: The defender passes to the attacker and closes down.
The attacker scores by stopping the ball on the end line behind the defender.
Swap roles after each attempt; keep score.
coaching_points: Attack the defender at speed, then slow before the move.
Use a feint or change of direction, then accelerate away.
Protect the ball with the body once past.

variations.title: Passive defender
variations.change: The defender jogs out and does not tackle; the attacker practises one move.
coaching_points: Pick one move and practise it at speed.
Drive at the defender before the move.
Accelerate away after the move.

variations.title: Live 1v1
variations.change: The defender competes fully.

variations.title: Five-second limit
variations.change: The attacker must score within five seconds of the first touch.

variations.title: Narrow channel
variations.change: Channel narrows to 6 m; the defender starts 3 m closer.
variations.setup: A 6 by 15 m channel. The defender starts 3 m in front of the end line with the ball, the attacker at the far end.
coaching_points: Less space: commit the defender before you change direction.
Use the body to protect the ball once past.
Stop the ball under control on the line.

media.caption: Close down, beat the defender, stop it on the line

steps.label: Defender passes to the attacker
Attacker drives forward; defender closes
Feint left, go right
Accelerate and stop it on the end line

drills.title: Goalkeeper catch and hold
drills.summary: Catch and hold shots at different heights, then progress to angles and rebounds.
drills.setup: A goal and a server 8 m out, central, with several balls.
instructions: The server volleys at the goalkeeper: chest height, then low, then high.
The goalkeeper catches, holds and rolls the ball back.
Ten strikes, then swap if two goalkeepers are working.
coaching_points: Get behind the line of the ball.
W-shaped hands for chest and high balls, scoop for low ones.
Set your feet before the ball is struck.

variations.title: Thrown at the body
variations.change: Server throws underarm straight at the goalkeeper from 6 m.
variations.setup: A goal and a server 6 m out with several balls.
instructions: The server throws underarm at the goalkeeper's chest and stomach.
The goalkeeper catches, holds and returns the ball.
Ten throws, then swap if two goalkeepers are working.

variations.title: Volleys at three heights
variations.change: Server volleys from 8 m at chest, low and high.

variations.title: Angled strikes
variations.change: Server strikes from cones 4 m either side of centre, alternating; the goalkeeper resets the angle before every strike.
variations.setup: A goal and a server 10 m out with several balls, alternating between two cones 4 m either side of centre.
instructions: The server strikes from one cone, then moves to the other for the next ball.
The goalkeeper shuffles across and sets a new position before each strike.
Ten strikes, alternating sides.
coaching_points: Move with the ball: stay on the line between ball and the centre of the goal.
Shuffle, do not cross the feet; be set before the strike.
Catch and hold; parry wide only if you cannot hold.

variations.title: Driven shots with a rebound
variations.change: Driven shots from 12 m; a second server follows in for any spilled ball.
variations.setup: A goal, a server 12 m out with balls, and a second server 6 m out to one side to follow in on rebounds.
instructions: The first server drives shots at the goalkeeper.
If the ball is spilled, the second server follows in to score.
The goalkeeper holds or parries wide, then recovers for the next shot.
coaching_points: Hold if you can; if not, parry wide, never back into the middle.
Recover your feet quickly after a save.
Set before each shot even when tired.

steps.label: Volley at chest height: catch with W-shaped hands
Hold, then roll it back
Low volley: get the body behind it and scoop
Roll it back; next one is high

media.caption: Easier: underarm throws at the body

steps.label: Underarm throw at the chest
Catch, hold, return
Throw at the stomach

media.caption: Harder: angled strikes, reset the angle every time

steps.label: Strike from the left cone; goalkeeper set on the near-post side
Return; server moves to the right cone, goalkeeper shuffles across
Server takes the ball to the right cone
Strike from the right: set before it is hit, catch and hold

media.caption: Harder: driven shot, spill, second server follows in

steps.label: S1 drives a shot at the goalkeeper
Goalkeeper parries wide; S2 follows in onto the loose ball
S2 shoots; goalkeeper recovers across and saves

media.caption: U10 goalkeeper diving drill, three variants (Northern Goalkeeping, 19 seconds).
Angled shooting: set and save from an angle (LVGK, 9 seconds).
